region_rule: hide all HUC6 labels; evaluate largest connected component inside HUC6

success_gate.metric: paired ΔMAE vs each baseline on fixed query cells
success_gate.bootstrap: cluster by task-month, 95% CI upper bound of ΔMAE < 0
success_gate.effect_size: MAE reduction vs best simple baseline >= 10%
success_gate.shuffle: gnn_true must beat gnn_shuf_values and gnn_shuf_sites significantly
success_gate.regions: at least 4 of 5 primary basins pass; no basin may worsen >5% and still claim overall success
success_gate.fallback_story: if only 1-2 basins pass, report river-type transferability instead of universal claim
